notes.title: CONTRA SPEM SPERO — OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]You find yourself in a place you never imagined could exist — one that remembers every decision you’ve tried to forget.[/h3]

Was your fate sealed the moment you stepped into the forest’s trap? Were these creatures truly once human? You can only hope you won’t share their fate. Because everything — and everyone — tells you this time, you won’t [i]leave[/i].

[previewyoutube=yuKXvSuda6g;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] [b]70,000+ words[/b] — choose a story that will stay on these pages forever.
[*] [b]4 endings[/b] — which one reveals the truth?
[*] [b]4+ hours per playthrough[/b] — with branching paths and hidden quests, completionists can expect 8+ hours of unique content across multiple playthroughs.
[*] [b]55 unique locations[/b] — the deeper you go, the stranger it gets.
[*] [b]Creatures[/b] — they are everywhere. Watching, waiting..
[/list]
To survive, you’ll need to listen. To understand.
Unravel their past. Accept your own.
Choose a side.
[list]
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302261/a98795abebcb0d37a0b76b48ab448b22eb654f2c.png[/img]
[/list]
To everyone who wishlisted, shared, or rooted for us — [b]thank you[/b]!
This release wouldn’t have been possible without your support. It’s been incredible to see such a kind and curious community grow around this surreal little world.

We hope this is only the beginning. We have so many stories left to tell — and we can’t wait to share them with you.

If you enjoyed the journey, please consider leaving a Steam review. Every bit of feedback helps us improve — and helps more players discover the game!


Brought to you by [b]DADZINGO[/b], the ones still searching for a way out.

notes.title: CONTRA SPEM SPERO RELEASES AUGUST 14
notes.content: [h3]Contra Spem Spero is finally coming out on August 14 — the very day everything changed.[/h3][p][/p][p]Trapped in an endless night, surrounded by things you can’t explain and creatures that were once human, you’re left with few choices. Listen to them.. and maybe you’ll find a way out.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether it’s another lost man, a desperate creature, a wandering observer, a mysterious entity, or someone indescribable — each carries a past that can shape your future. What future will you decide to embrace?[/p][p]And what future do you truly deserve? [/p][p][/p][h3]It won’t be long before the answer becomes clear.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302261/a98c9c697a1af5e93579bcf7fd33ffd77861e7b0.png"][/img][/p][p]Stay connected with us for more on the road to release. After all, one can never have too many souls, right? Go get ‘em already![/p][p][/p][p]Strolling through the forest’s labyrinth,[/p][p][b]DADZINGO[/b][/p][p][url=https://discord.gg/aDYgYq2YN9][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45302261/0cee82817961f5c5f6fa013c6f4b9580c6a12b21.png[/img][/url][/p][p][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/dadzingo][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45302261/17cd44fd95d1db6dd96ebeec5366391e19dca2d2.png[/img][/url][/p]

notes.title: THE WAIT IS ALMOST OVER
notes.content: [h3]At the beginning of next month, the wait will finally end!
